name: shopalarm
description: Intruder alarms on shopfronts. Breaching a lock with an alarm panel behind it arms a countdown whose length is the panel's model; `hack alarm` opens a wire-trace board running on whatever is left of that clock. Beat it and nobody knows. Miss it and the box calls SPECTER-PD itself — 4 stars, forced witness, police on the way, and the shelves still there.
